verdict.rationale: Instinct's own docs and hands-on reviews show it taking delegated tasks, running them on its own (calls, bookings, follow-ups), and reporting back in the same chat. It also proactively texts or calls the user. However, nothing documents scheduling a task for a set time or setting up recurring runs. Missing for 10: explicit one-off scheduling at a specified time, recurring or cron-style task scheduling, and any first-party docs describing a task scheduler.
